observed_computation.unit: single validation row group, corresponding to one sequence
observed_computation.operation: for each sequence and age-by-market_class-by-target cell, calculate the weighted centered target variance over selected rows, then sum these within-sequence centered variances across sequences
observed_computation.centering: within sequence, not across all sequences pooled into the reported stratum

correct_interpretation: sum of within-sequence weighted target variances for the cell; between-sequence variation in target means is omitted, so this is not the fully pooled target-variance sum for the entire age-by-market_class-by-target stratum

downstream_effect.weighted_mse_formula: sum of weighted squared prediction errors divided by sum of weights, both accumulated across all rows in the stratum

required_use: Treat this field only as a within-sequence variance diagnostic. Do not use it as the denominator of a pooled stratum WP or as the total target variance when decomposing between/within-sequence variation.
scope_and_action: Append-only clarification; no source script, raw follow-up JSON, prediction array, grade, or score was changed or recomputed.
